name: TheForge Smart COD Control & Fraud Blocker for WooCommerce
author: The Plugin Forge

sections.description:
Tired of fake Cash-on-Delivery orders eating into your profits? This plugin gives WooCommerce store owners complete control over when COD is available — and automatically blocks high-risk customers before they place an order.

No external APIs. No monthly fees. Just smart, local fraud prevention.

Why Store Owners Choose This Plugin

✅ Stops fraud at checkout — COD is hidden before bad orders are placed, not after
✅ Zero performance impact — Runs only during checkout, no page slowdowns
✅ 100% private — All data stays in your database, nothing sent externally
✅ Works everywhere — HPOS, Blocks checkout, multisite, and classic themes
✅ Built for high-COD markets — India, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa

What It Does

🌍 Geographic Controls

Block or allow COD by country, state, or postal code — perfect for limiting COD to verified delivery zones.

💰 Order Value Limits

Set minimum and maximum cart totals for COD eligibility. Stop high-risk big-ticket orders or enforce minimum purchase thresholds.

💵 COD Handling Fee

Add a customizable handling fee to discourage impulsive fake orders. Fee label and amount are fully configurable.

🕒 Schedule Control

Restrict COD to specific days of the week and time windows. Block late-night orders that are statistically higher risk.

👥 User Role Restrictions

Allow COD only for verified customers or specific WordPress roles. Block guests or first-time buyers automatically.

📦 Product & Category Controls

Disable COD for specific products or entire categories — ideal for electronics, luxury goods, and high-value items.

🎟️ Coupon Protection

Prevent COD when promotional coupons are applied. Stops customers from combining discounts with unverified COD orders.

⚖️ Weight-Based Rules

Set cart weight limits for COD — protect fragile, bulky, or expensive-to-return shipments.

📊 Behavior Risk Scoring

Rule-based customer scoring using order history, cancellation patterns, and account age. Automatically identify high-risk buyers.

🛡️ Manual Approval Workflow

Put suspicious orders on hold for admin review. Approve or reject COD orders directly from your WooCommerce dashboard.

🚫 Auto-Blacklist

Automatically block customers after a configurable number of failed deliveries or cancellations. Set it once — it handles repeat offenders forever.

🔒 Manual Blacklist

Instantly block any email address or phone number from using COD. Simple one-click management.

📋 Fraud Logs

Every blocked attempt is logged with customer details, block reason, cart total, and location. Know exactly what’s being stopped and why.

🗺️ Fraud Heatmap

Visual geographic analytics showing where COD fraud attempts are concentrated — by postal code and region.

🧪 Test Simulator

Test your rules against any scenario without placing a real order. Validate your configuration before going live.

Real-World Use Cases

  • Block COD for orders over ₹20,000 / $500 to limit financial risk
  • Allow COD only for verified pin codes in metro areas
  • Add ₹50 handling fee to reduce impulse fake orders
  • Auto-block customers with 3+ failed deliveries
  • Disable COD between 10 PM and 8 AM
  • Block COD on electronics and jewellery categories
  • Require admin approval for all first-time buyer COD orders

Quick Setup

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Smart COD Control
  2. Enable the plugin and set your cart limits
  3. Add location or schedule rules as needed
  4. Use the Test tab to verify rules
  5. Save — your store is now protected

Privacy & Data Collection

What is logged (blocked orders only): email, phone, IP address, cart total, location, timestamp, and block reason.

Data storage:
* Stored locally in your WordPress database
* No external servers or APIs
* No cookies, no tracking

GDPR/CCPA: Store owners should include this plugin in their privacy policy, inform customers about fraud prevention logging, and provide data deletion on request. Full removal via uninstall.php when the plugin is deleted.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+ (Tested up to 6.9.4)
  • WooCommerce 5.0+ (Tested up to 10.6.1)
  • PHP 7.4+
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) ✓
  • WooCommerce Blocks Checkout ✓
  • Multisite ✓
  • No external dependencies ✓
sections.installation:
Automatic

  1. Log in to WordPress admin
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Smart COD Control & Fraud Blocker”
  4. Click Install Now then Activate

Manual

  1. Download the plugin ZIP
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Configuration

Navigate to WooCommerce → Smart COD Control and configure via the tabs:

  • General — Enable plugin, set order limits and COD fee
  • Location — Country, state, and postal code rules
  • Advanced — Schedule, roles, products, coupons, weight, scoring, approval, auto-blacklist
  • Blacklist — Manually block emails and phone numbers
  • Logs — View all blocked COD attempts
  • Test — Simulate rules before going live
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce 5.0 or higher must be installed and active.

Will this affect other payment methods?

No. Only the COD payment option is affected. All other gateways remain unchanged.

Can I limit COD to specific countries or pin codes?

Yes. Use the Location tab to allow COD by country, state, or postal code.

How does the blacklist work?

When a customer enters a blacklisted email or phone number at checkout, the COD option is hidden for them.

Are blocked attempts logged?

Yes. Every blocked attempt is saved with the customer’s details, the reason, and a timestamp.

Can I export fraud logs?

Log viewing and deletion are available in the Logs tab. CSV export is planned for a future release.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. It runs only during checkout and has minimal overhead.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. Fully translation-ready with a .pot file included.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

All settings and logs are preserved and restored when you reactivate.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

All plugin data, settings, and logs are permanently removed from the database via uninstall.php.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes, full Blocks checkout support is included.

Is it multisite compatible?

Yes. Can be activated network-wide or per site.

Does it send data to external servers?

No. All data is stored locally. No external APIs or services are used.
